title: Dynamic_Music
description: Play all Minecraft tracks and add your own MP3 music directly into the game with a clean and easy-to-use GUI.
body:
🎵 Music Player Mod — play your favorite music directly in Minecraft!

This mod adds a fully functional music player to Minecraft. Listen to every in-game soundtrack, switch tracks anytime, and create the perfect atmosphere while building, exploring, or fighting.

✨ Features:
• Play all Minecraft music tracks
• Support for custom MP3 files
• Clean and user-friendly GUI
• Playlist and quick track switching
• In-game volume control
• Background music playback
• Resource pack & custom soundtrack support

Simply put your MP3 files into the mod folder and enjoy your own music while playing Minecraft!

Fabric only.

To open GUI, press **_N_**
